class.name: OcgGCMakescale2d
class.brief_description: This class implements elementary construction algorithms for scaling transformations in 2D space. The result is a `Geom2d_Transformation`. A `GC_MakeScale2d` object provides a framework for: - defining the transformation parameters; - running the construction algorithm; - querying the resulting transformation via `Value()`.
